extracted.intended_audience: Investigators/administrative personnel preparing NIH PHS 398 biosketches for grant applications (PD/PI and key personnel)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and required content/format for individual biographical sketches (PHS 398/2590) for key personnel and other significant contributors on NIH grant applications. Covers required sections (A–D), formatting fields, ordering, and page limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch required sections (A–D)
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the key personnel and other significant contributors in the order listed on Form Page 2. Follow this format for each person. A. Personal Statement B. Positions and Honors C. Peer-Reviewed Publications (Selected ...) D. Research Support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The biosketch must be organized into the labeled sections A–D for each listed person; use this order and format for every key person or significant contributor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page length limit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each individual biographical sketch must not exceed four pages in total (all sections combined). Keep content concise to fit within the four-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ordering of entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the key personnel and other significant contributors in the order listed on Form Page 2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The biographical sketches should be presented in the same order as the personnel appear on Form Page 2 of the application to ensure consistency and ease of review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification and header fields
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME … POSITION TITLE … eRA COMMONS USER NAME:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name, position title, and eRA Commons user name (where applicable) at the top of the biosketch for identification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training block format and content
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, and include postdoctoral training.) INSTITUTION AND LOCATION  DEGREE  YEAR(s)  FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List education and training beginning with the baccalaureate (or initial professional degree) and include postdoctoral training. Provide institution/location, degree, years, and field of study in a tabular or clearly delineated format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement content and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement — a brief narrative describing the individual's qualifications and relevance to the proposed research (examples in text explain goals and roles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the personal statement to summarize the individual's experience, qualifications, prior collaborations, and the specific role they will play in the proposed project. Show how prior work and expertise make the person well suited to carry out their proposed responsibilities (examples of model personal statements are provided in the document).

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors (employment and recognition)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors — employment history and honors/awards (with dates and roles) should be listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological list of employment/positions (with dates and appointment type where appropriate) and a list of honors, awards, professional society memberships, and other recognitions relevant to the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer-reviewed publications — selection and ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Peer-Reviewed Publications (Selected from [N]) Most relevant to the current application (in chronologic order)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List peer-reviewed publications selected for relevance to the application; select the most relevant items rather than complete bibliographies. Present them in chronological order and include citation details such as journal, year, volume/pages and, where available, PMID/PMCID.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support — ongoing and completed
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support — Ongoing Research Support and Completed Research Support entries that include funding source, grant number, dates, project title/aims, and role (e.g., PI, Co-Investigator, Advisor).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate current (ongoing) from completed support. For each award include the sponsor (NIH institute or other), grant number, project title, dates, brief description of aims/goals, and the individual's role on the award. Use concise descriptions emphasizing relevance to the current application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form identifier and revision/version
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the correct PHS 398 form and note the revision/version (here Rev. 06/09) as the template/format for the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use for key personnel and significant contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the key personnel and other significant contributors in the order listed on Form Page 2. Follow this format for each person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the same required sections, fields, and page limits to all key personnel and other significant contributors listed on the application; ensure consistency across all biographical sketches.
